# Claude Pet

> Claude Pet is a free macOS desktop companion and Claude usage monitor, with public source on GitHub. Choose a pet, let it roam, and read usage percentages and reset countdowns from one small pill (number colour = source, label colour = how much is left). Roadmap: Codex usage first, then Gemini, Grok and other AI services in the same pill.

Reference version: v0.24, published 2026-09-12. Reference updated: 2026-09-12.
Claude Pet is an independent project by Yeongyu Yang (uygnoey), not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic PBC.

## Key facts

- Platform: macOS 12 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel; Windows 10/11 beta from v0.24 (unsigned zip, claude-pet-win.zip). No separate Python installation is needed for the packaged apps.
- Install: Apple Silicon uses ClaudePet.dmg; Intel uses ClaudePet-universal.dmg. Open the disk image, move ClaudePet.app to Applications, and launch. ZIP alternatives are also published. The release describes the app as Apple-notarized.
- Account: sign in to Claude Code first. Exact mode uses its existing OAuth credential from macOS Keychain to request Anthropic's server-computed account usage percentages and reset times.
- Estimate: when server usage is unavailable, local fallback estimates activity recorded in Claude Code logs under ~/.claude. Web or desktop activity absent from those logs is not counted. Optional calibration applies to this estimate, not the server percentage.
- Companion: screen roaming, occasional cursor following at a distance, and monitor hopping. Roaming can be toggled in the right-click menu; the usage pill tucks away while the pet moves.
- Pets: built-in cat plus bundled dog, fox, scorpion and elephant. Switch in the right-click menu or add compatible pet.json and sprite-sheet files in a folder under ~/.claude_pet/pets.
- Updates in v0.24: automatic checks every hour after launch, not at launch. Right-click → Check for updates… checks immediately and installs a newer release if available.
- Privacy: local log parsing happens on the Mac. Exact mode contacts Anthropic with the Claude Code credential; update checks and downloads contact GitHub. Do not describe the app as offline-only.
- Optional Admin API mode reports Console organization costs, separately from subscription limits. The configured Admin API key is stored in plaintext in ~/.claude_pet.json.
- Public source is available. Do not infer a software license from that fact.

## 한국어 요약

Claude Pet은 Claude 사용량을 확인할 수 있는 무료 macOS 데스크톱 펫입니다. 고양이·강아지·여우·전갈·코끼리를 고르고 화면 산책과 커서 따라다니기를 사용할 수 있습니다. 정확 모드는 Anthropic 서버의 사용률을 표시하고, 로컬 대체 모드는 Claude Code 로그만 추정합니다. macOS 12 이상에서 동작하며 Intel Mac은 universal 빌드를 사용합니다.
